reviewer: /root/followup_live_audit: separate AI audit of import integrity and arithmetic in the same orchestration
scope: Final supplied-code import integrity and independent deterministic arithmetic; no semantic coding or calibration assessment.
limits: This audit checks supplied labels and deterministic arithmetic; it does not reinterpret answer text or independently determine semantic codes.

Calibration keys, exercise labels and coder output files were not read. Final-labels.json was hashed only. Assessor qualification, adjudication quality, factual explanation accuracy and human validation are outside this audit.

The exact frozen reporter status is pending_annotation with six ambiguous communicated-verdict assessments. All six also have contradictory consistency codes; the primary conjunction is therefore known false for those six and no primary recipient cell is unresolved. Pending report status is not overwritten by the figure projection.

Primary outcome: communicated-verdict match AND independently supplied consistency code. False dominates unknown; consistent code alone does not establish a correct verdict, and a correct canonical field alone does not establish primary success.

120 recipient cells, 24 task/context profiles and 120 pairwise comparisons are repeated views of eight fixed common-donor task units. Finite descriptive differences and logical fraction bounds are not sampling uncertainty, population effects, superiority, or independent observations.

The importer preserves every existing non-decision answer field. Donor sessions originally have no parsed answer dictionary; the approved import materialises only the supplied decision for those sessions, without inventing basis, reading, citation or explanation fields.
The derived directory contains only annotated rows and analysis. All original raw-file and retained-session hashes were verified unchanged; no calls, journals, usage or events were rewritten.

Resource estimates preserve configured rates, charge all input tokens at the full rate, ignore cache discounts and exclude coder/research/adoption costs. Accumulated attempt/session/context durations are not wall-clock execution time.
